messages:
Ava (AE): @here quick sales->CS handoff for Greenfield Labs :wave:
Ava (AE): TL;DR: $120k ARR, signed annual Dedicated plan, kickoff scheduled next Tue 10am PT. Primary goals: productionize chat + nightly batch embeddings for search. Renewal in 11 months.
Ava (AE): Current status: SSO partially configured (IdP metadata uploaded), trial keys active, early test traffic hitting hosted endpoints. Customer ran a couple large batch jobs and saw timeouts/slow tails. They asked about dedicated capacity and quantization recommendations.
Ava (AE): Risks: adoption is low (only 2 users running jobs so far), one critical blocker = nightly embedding jobs failing intermittently (timeouts ~30% on >100k-item jobs). If we don't stabilize batch flow they may delay rollout -> renewal risk.
Ava (AE): Customer contacts: Priya Shah (CTO) <priya@greenfield.example>, Mark (ML lead) for infra.
Ava (AE): Ask: Sam can you take CSM ownership for onboarding + adoption? Lina/Eng, can you triage the batch timeouts and advise a mitigation plan? Devon please add any SSO/config context.

Sam (CSM): Got it, assigning myself as primary CSM. I'll run kickoff, enablement sessions, and own adoption checklist. Noted renewal horizon.
Sam (CSM): Immediate actions I plan: 1) Kickoff + runbook review next Tue, 2) Weekly health sync for first 6 weeks, 3) Post-kickoff NPS + prompt set feedback capture.

Priya (CS Ops): I'll prepare enablement materials and a short ops checklist for their infra team (SSO checklist, Dedicated sizing guide, batching best-practices). Proposed training times: Wed 3/9 or Thu 3/10 11am PT — which works?

Lina (Support): Can you paste a failing job log or a minimal repro? Need to know: request payload size, concurrency, model variant, timeout config. Also please confirm whether jobs hit hosted endpoints or Dedicated (customer mentioned Dedicated plan but tests were on hosted).

Ava (AE): Repro snippet Mark shared (redacted):
```
# customer batch run
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
payload: 100k items, chunk_size=512
timeout: 300s
responses: many 504 / socket timeout
```
Ava (AE): They ran against hosted, then asked about Dedicated for better tail latency.

Jordan (Eng): @Lina I can take the perf investigation. Need the exact payload and a sample dataset (or a synthetic that reproduces tail). Also what model/config? e.g., `open-embed-4096` or quantized variant?
Jordan (Eng): Suggest running our localized perf test: 
```
# run local perf harness
./perf_test --endpoint https://staging.redwood.ai --model open-embed-4096 --batch 128 --concurrency 4 --items 100000
```
Jordan (Eng): If reproduction looks similar we'll try KV cache tweaks and batching policy changes.

Devon (SE): SSO notes: when IdP metadata is uploaded they still need to finish attribute mapping (email vs user_id). If they try to SAML-login before mapping is done we see some session drop issues. I'll DM Mark the exact steps. Also, for Dedicated sizing my reco: start with 2x A10g equivalent for nightly batches and scale after 2 weeks of telemetry.

Lina (Support): I'll open a support ticket and link it here. Please drop the failing job payload to the ticket. ops-bot: create ticket for Greenfield batch timeouts -> INC-2034
ops-bot: Ticket created: https://redwood.ai/t/INC-2034 (assigned to eng-support queue)

Sam (CSM): Owners + next steps (compact):
- Sam (CSM): onboarding kickoff (owner) — schedule Tue 10am PT (confirmed) — due: 2034568000
- Lina (Support) & Jordan (Eng): triage INC-2034, reproduce, and propose mitigation (owner) — initial findings due: 2034568200
- Devon (SE): finish SSO attribute mapping doc & DM Mark — due: 2034567950 (today EOD)
- Priya (CS Ops): enablement deck + ops checklist — due: 2034568400
- Sam: post-kickoff NPS + feedback capture plan + prompt set collection — due: 2034569000

Sam (CSM): Measures of success: nightly batch runs stable (>=98% success), 2-week active users >= 8, completion of SSO without manual fixes.

Jordan (Eng): I'll start by running the perf harness. If we can't repro, ask Mark for a sanitized sample dataset or a recording of the client run.

Ava (AE): Thanks team. One more: Priya (CTO) asked for a regular cost estimate for Dedicated vs hosted for their expected monthly tokens — Priya, I'll send the initial estimate doc after kickoff.

Priya (CS Ops): Noted. I'll include cost comparison slide in enablement deck.

Sam (CSM): I'll post a weekly health summary to this thread after each sync. If anyone needs to be looped into the health report (sales/legal/finops) mention here.

Ava (AE): Thanks all — marking handoff complete from Sales side. :white_check_mark:
